correctness.rationale: Each busy trajectory with N=j has j-1 arrivals, j departures, and 2j-1 exponential waiting times of rate lambda+mu. Its Catalan path density is theta^(j-1)mu^j t^(2j-2)e^-(theta+mu)t/[j!(j-1)!]. Therefore T|N=j is Gamma(2j-1,theta+mu); conditional jump ordering and waiting-time simplex given the pair are parameter independent, giving Blackwell equivalence to full unmarked within-busy paths. Log likelihood is S log((lambda+eta)/lambda)-eta U, so exact gamma/ballot weights and the Gamma CDF at q S give both NP errors. Conditional likelihood changes sign under either marginal observation, making paired TV strictly larger. E[S]=lambda/(mu-lambda), E[U]=1/(mu-lambda) give exact KL pair and positive count-only information gap; score variance is 1/[lambda(mu-lambda)], giving LAN Gaussian total error. Small-eta expansion plus the pooled-Poisson initiating-customer source mark yields Kpair=mu sqrt(2/[lambda(mu-lambda)]). Fresh independently generated ballot-Gamma sums at (lambda,mu,eta,k)=(1,3,0.25,2) give alpha 0.286581758460309, beta 0.632887806741184, plus KL and Fisher comparisons. Analytic arguments justify infinite sums, strict inequalities and limits.
